  2. Confirm address, time window, and total. Shoppers verify the delivery address, pick a preferred arrival window, and review the order total before submitting.

  3. Prepay online and prepare ID. Payment happens in advance through the website, and a valid ID must be ready to show the driver at drop-off.

  4. Track, receive, and earn rewards. Customers get order status updates, accept the delivery in person, and earn rewards points on completed purchases.
